episode_summary: In this episode, Michael Opyd discusses the challenges of scaling a real estate business while managing multiple commitments. He emphasizes the importance of aligning business activities with personal strengths and reducing non-essential commitments to focus on high-impact tasks. The conversation provides insights into maintaining consistency in follow-up and the long-term mindset needed for success in real estate.
